title: Motion Blocks Registry Item
description: Contract for a single Motion Blocks registry item. Field names are inherited from shadcn's registry-item schema where they overlap, but the set of allowed fields and item types is narrowed to what Motion Blocks's CLI and docs site actually use.

$schema.description: Should reference this schema's URL once manifests adopt it.

name.description: Kebab-case registry item identifier, unique across the catalog.

type.description: What kind of item this is. registry:lib is for shared helpers under src/registry/lib.

title.description: Human-readable display name shown in docs and CLI output.

description.description: Short summary shown in docs, list output, and info output.

dependencies.description: npm package names to install alongside this item. No version syntax.

registryDependencies.description: Names of other Motion Blocks registry items (including hidden registry:lib helpers) this item depends on. No version syntax.

docs.description: Optional freeform notes shown alongside an item's docs entry.

meta.description: Unrestricted bag for tooling-specific metadata, e.g. meta.hidden to keep an item out of normal catalog browsing.

usage.description: Ordered list of framework-labeled usage examples shown in docs.

props.description: Optional, docs-level description of the element's public props/attributes.

path.description: Source-relative path to the file. Generated payloads rewrite this to a full src/registry/<group>/<name>/... path.

target.description: Path the consumer's project should install this file at.

content.description: Inlined file content. Only present in generated payloads, and only for text/code files. Source manifests must omit this; binary assets must never use it.

asset.description: Marks a binary/image file. Asset files are referenced by url, never inlined as content.

url.description: Absolute URL the asset is served from. Required when asset is set.
